notes:
Print selection replaces event stamps: every card surface now offers only the prints the card was actually made in (Normal / Holo / Reverse Holo), plus a 1st Edition checkbox where one exists. Staff, Prerelease, League and Pokemon Center are no longer selectable variants; existing lines are migrated to notes so they price from their real printing again, and a stale stamp price can no longer become a card's headline value.

Debug build of the PocketVendorTCG Android app (debug-signed). Sideload for testing.
